items.q: Do I need a finished product?
items.a: No. We help you start from day one, your books grow with you.
Yes, isolated workspaces, roles, projects and legal exports are built-in.

items.a: No. Clarity and structure apply to any organization.
Yes, magic-link auth, GDPR exports, activity log, and we're reachable.

residency.title: Data residency
items: Database hosted on Convex (EU - Paris region)
Documents stored on Backblaze B2 (EU - Central, Frankfurt)
Workspaces are fully isolated; cross-workspace access is denied by construction
All writes are recorded in the activity log for legal traceability
Workspace owners can export all data as JSON at any time (GDPR)
